scope: Moving forty-enemy swarm with stock eight-round bolter, declared jam stress, frostwave/battlecry, ten dash intents, and scheduled stock burn/salve exposure through normal status paths. Scrapbot bite remains zero to isolate injury from the defined hazard schedule. Rally plus salve uses the stock surge reaction and its healing/movement multiplier. Jam stress variant: jam threshold 200 per mille, normal identity-derived salts and three clear pulls. This samples repeated failure/recovery, not the stock jam frequency.
limits: Spawn requests enter through each game's existing development path at different scheduling boundaries.
Population, body lifetimes, shot totals and loot attribution are measured, not assumed identical.
Callback time includes networking, simulation and presentation; it is not CPU-only.
Kit uses owner-streamed movement; Replay simulates movement authoritatively and predicts it.
Ability admission/origin and status replication timing differ; measure exposure instead of assuming the same transient effects.
Player burn/salve exposure is scheduled by the host fixture; normal status decay, damage/healing and rollback execute afterward. This does not measure natural incoming-hit rates.
Dash is owner-clocked in Kit and fixed-tick predicted in Replay; actual distance, durations and observation edges may differ.
Lossy datagrams include ENet reliable retransmissions; correctness/recovery intervals are measured separately from the delay-only condition.
Unavailable authority frames during resync are recorded explicitly, not interpreted as zero health. At most two seconds of the lossy window may be unavailable.

The isolated Replay copy explicitly uses receipt-time cooperative actions. Stock Replay schedules other actions while dash uses a versioned receipt-time policy; the fixture explicitly disables that classifier and selects receipt timing for every action.
Kit and Replay derive salts from different identity numbers; actual deterministic jam streams and shot totals differ and are checked individually. A final uncleared jam is valid and must converge.

freshness.reason: A received authority frame advances at snapshot delivery boundaries. Both endpoints may be up to 30 ticks behind contiguous facts; compare inclusive 20-second process windows and report actual advance/lag.

cast_submission_contract: Kit immediate Action_Outcome sequence identifies a sent client command even when local prediction rejects. Authority application and observed cooldown/status work remain separately required.

dash_delivery.replay: Receipt action with sequence and settled verdict
